surface: plate_core pr babysit watch loop (upcoming wiring)
summary: Add exponential poll backoff and watch stop conditions for cheap PR babysitting (#1079).
migration_impact: No downstream action until a later release wires the module into gh plate pr babysit --watch. Upgrading plate-core only adds the helper module.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core when the Epic #1077 integration PR lands.
2. Until then, existing --watch behavior is unchanged.
agent_notes: Use plate_core.pr_watch_backoff.Backoff for quiet-tick intervals (reset on PR change, cap at max_interval). Use should_stop with injectable WatchClock in tests. Do not poll at a fixed 60s interval once wired.
